name: kustodela-pos
description: Orquestación del entorno local de Kustodela POS (backend + frontend + Zitadel + PostgreSQL)

scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait && tsx scripts/zitadel-bootstrap.ts && npm --prefix Gorditas_Calerence_Backend run migrate:deploy
scripts.prod:up: docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres zitadel-api zitadel-login caddy pg-backup backend && docker compose run --rm --build frontend-build
scripts.prod:sync-redirects: docker compose exec backend npx tsx scripts/sync-redirect-uris.ts
